title: Debounce and throttle recorder
label: Music-box recorder: a cabinet carries a large pin disc; a gantry arm holds the throttle and debounce dashpots, two graduated scales and a 500 ms dial; a comb reaches over the disc and a knurled knob turns it.
caption: Each click of the knob is a call: the disc turns and a grey pin drops. The throttle dashpot fires at most once per 500 ms and sets a black pin each time; the debounce dashpot waits for the turning to stop, then sets one large pin.

states.name: idle
